children: DICK'S Sporting Goods reported pro forma combined net sales of $21,781,120,000 for the fiscal year ended Jan. 31, 2026 following its acquisition of Foot Locker.
Completed Foot Locker acquisition on Sept. 8, 2025 for ~$2.5B in cash and ~9.6M DICK'S shares, pro forma net sales $21.78B.
Issued $381.9M of 4.000% senior notes due Oct. 1, 2029 as part of an exchange offer; $18.1M of Foot Locker notes remained outstanding.
Pro forma net income of $563.95M for FY26, with basic EPS of $6.35 and diluted EPS of $6.21 after reflecting the share issuance.
Pro forma excludes expected cost synergies, integration savings and related realization; prepared under ASC 805 and illustrative only.
